LeaderboardEntry.title: Leaderboard Entry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Represents a user's high score on the leaderboard.

userId.description: User's unique identifier (Firebase Auth UID or Telegram ID if authenticated).

username.description: User's display name or Telegram username.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last score update.

leaderboard.description: Stores the highest scores for each user.
